property_summary: For any caller and any sequence where a caller deposits X then later deposits Y, the reference contract's stored balance equals X+Y (i.e., addToBalance accumulates deposits); the mutant that sets balance = msg.value breaks this by making the stored balance equal only to the last deposit for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the update to set the balance to msg.value instead of adding, so balance becomes only the last deposit amount.
